name: Sauti 116 child helpline
what: Free helpline for children and young people, day and night. Tell them what happened and they help you get care and protection.

name: Police emergency
what: For danger right now. Say where you are and what is happening. 112 also works.

name: Child and Family Protection Unit
what: Police officers trained to help girls and families, at the nearest police post. Ask for the Child and Family Protection officer. A GirlCare72 responder can go with you.

name: Health centre: PEP, emergency pills, HIV test
what: Care within 72 hours of forced or unprotected sex can stop HIV and pregnancy. GirlCare72 sends a free ride.

name: GBV case management agency
what: Trained case workers who listen, keep it private and plan the next steps with you.

name: Counselling
what: Someone to talk to about stress, fear or sadness, as many times as you need.

name: Legal aid
what: Free lawyers who explain your rights and help with a police case or court, including child marriage and defilement.

name: Safe shelter
what: A safe place to stay for a while when home is not safe. A responder arranges it the same day.
